_comment: Resource policy for GitHub Actions. Read by scripts/ci_gate.py, which reports it as ADVISORY. Nothing here gates a job.
notes: paused: reported by the gate and by docs/ACTIONS_LEDGER.md. It currently gates NO job, because
there are no discretionary scheduled or research jobs; essential checks always run.
max_minutes_per_run must equal the workflow's timeout-minutes. A test fails if they diverge.
max_runs_per_day is advisory only. The ledger is written into a read-only checkout and does
not persist between runs, so no daily limit can be enforced from it. Do not describe this as
Nothing here monitors monthly usage, billing or alerts. Those are outside this repository.
